{{Top|leg}}
The '''flechétte missile launcher''' was a specialized [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]] used to deploy [[flechétte missile]]s. These launchers were commonly installed in [[BTL-S8 K-wing assault starfighter]]s.
